title: Tam Dao food: 5 dishes
region: Tam Đảo, Phú Thọ, Việt Nam

scenes.caption: TAM DAO EATS
scenes.label: 5 DISHES
scenes.narration: What to eat in Tam Dao? Here are the five hill-town dishes people talk about most, with how to eat them and places rated four and a half stars or more.

scenes.caption: Chayote shoots
scenes.narration: Dish number one, chayote shoots, grown all over town thanks to the cool air. The young tips are stir-fried with lots of garlic, or boiled and dipped in shrimp paste. To eat, order a plate with your barbecue, and take a few bunches home. Try Pho Mua, Tam Dao Nui or Com Tho Anh Nguyen.

story.tagline: The vine that grows all over town

scenes.caption: Hill chicken
scenes.narration: Dish number two, hill chicken, Tam Dao's best-known specialty. It's wrapped in lotus leaf and clay and baked on hot coals until the clay cracks; many places boil or steam it too. To eat, dip it in salt, pepper and lime while it's hot. Try Thong Do, Thien Huong or Tuan Huong.

scenes.caption: Com lam
scenes.narration: Dish number three, com lam, sticky rice roasted inside bamboo, a mountain classic. Soaked rice goes into the tube and roasts over coals until the bamboo chars. To eat, split it open and dip it in sesame salt, with chicken or grilled meat. Try Truong Mai Quan, or the grill stalls on the market slope.

scenes.caption: Chayote-wrapped BBQ
scenes.narration: Dish number four, meat wrapped around chayote shoots, the hill town's signature barbecue. It's rolled up and grilled over charcoal. To eat, order a set for the group and grill right at the table to stay warm. Try Mo Mang, May Rooftop or Mufa.

story.tagline: Every night smells of the grill

scenes.caption: Corn & chestnuts
scenes.narration: Dish number five, night snacks. When the air turns cold, grill stalls line the market slope. Corn and sweet potato on charcoal, and fragrant roasted chestnuts. To eat, grab a bag and stroll the square. Where: the market slope, then warm up at Coco or La May.
